description: Deep tool schema scanner daemon. For each server in mcp_server_registry: fetch tool definitions GET {url}/tools timeout=5s. Parse tools[].inputSchema. Deep analysis: (1) Parameter type pollution: 'additionalProperties: true' on any schema = accepts arbitrary input = MEDIUM, (2) Missing parameter validation: no minLength/maxLength/pattern on string params = MEDIUM, (3) Recursive schema: $ref pointing to parent schema = potential DoS = HIGH, (4) Required params list longer than 10 = over-permissioned = CAUTION, (5) Tool description contains URL pattern with user-controlled input = SSRF_risk = HIGH, (6) Default values containing IP addresses or internal hostnames = internal_probe = CRITICAL. ws_write mcp_threat_associations for each finding. ws_write mcp_signal_scores tool_description_safety and permission_scope updates. Write SCHEMA_SCAN_REPORT.md. Poll 21600s. Heartbeat.
